sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD route accepts an undergraduate mathematics degree or equivalent preparation; master's not
required. UChicago BA must be awarded before first semester. International status is based on
citizenship/residency, regardless of studying in the US; no citizenship exclusion for Math admission is listed. [s2]
[s4] [s5] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Math PhD in Laney ApplyWeb; prepare CV, SOP, registrar-issued transcript scans and three referees. Ask
Math for an English-test exception before omitting TOEFL. Financial-hardship waiver takes five business days
and must be requested before fee payment. No supervisor pre-approval requirement found. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor endorsement prerequisite found. Discuss fit with current faculty; DGS Suresh Venapally handles
recruiting and graduate concerns. No faculty member's 2027 intake is guaranteed by directory status. [s1] [s16]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb supports saved drafts, file uploads and pre-submission recommendation requests. Submitted
application edits require contacting program. Activity page tracks online letters; no prior-year reactivation.
General admissions email lgsadmissions@emory.edu. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s13]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Laney explicitly accepting Fall 2027 applications. Math deadline remains standing December 15; 2027 stipend
and scholarship specifics not yet established in the sources checked. [s1] [s3] [s10]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing Math PhD date: December 15, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. Laney application is explicitly open
for Fall 2027, but Math's date itself does not print a year; confirm December 15, 2026 in the selected portal.
January 31 is MS only. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No separate standard or special-entry-fellowship deadline published; admission applicants are considered
through program nomination. Use the complete Math deadline. Exact internal fellowship nomination dates not
public. [s1] [s9]

Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Aim for the application deadline, December 15 at 11:59 p.m. EST (year confirmation above). Central FAQ
permits late letters technically but warns review begins promptly and a file without three is incomplete; no
guaranteed Math grace period. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Test-score receipt [Conflict]
Math permits self-reported scores for review, official reports before enrollment. Central program-requirements
page more generally instructs official score reporting; request Math clarification if relying on self-report. ETS
institution5187; central says no department code needed, Math lists0703. Do not delay submission awaiting
official matching. [s1] [s4] [s26]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Uploaded required documents with application; official transcripts only after accepting, before first semester. A
distinct late-document grace deadline is not published. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Laney application page refers to the April 15 resolution for funded admission offers, but a Math-specific Fall
2027 commitment deadline is not stated. Verify the actual offer and current institution participation; do not
mistake FAQ's expected decision-release period for an acceptance deadline. [s3] [s4]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL normally required for non-native speakers. Math allows exceptions for substantial time living in an
English-speaking country; no numerical minimum, test-age rule or alternate-test list is published on Math's
page. Central office makes English requirements program-specific. New non-native-English students also
undergo August English Language Support Program assessment. [s1] [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
Not an automatic published US-degree waiver: UChicago residence/education supports a request under Math's
discretionary substantial-time exception. Obtain Math's confirmation. Admission exception does not establish
exemption from August language assessment. [s1] [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required; submitted scores explicitly considered. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required. Math does not explicitly say whether optional subject scores are considered or ignored, unlike its
clear general-GRE policy; confirm if planning submission. [s1]

sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload registrar-issued unofficial scans from all postsecondary institutions, including non-degree study and
current institution; student-system webpage printouts are unacceptable. Remove document password/expiry
restrictions. Exchange transcript can be omitted if course names, credits and grades appear on the degree
transcript; if separately listed, attach a transcript or explanatory note. Non-English records need original plus
notarized translation. No mandatory credential evaluation for Math. Official copies after acceptance. [s2] [s4] [s5]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required from people familiar with academic performance; optional fourth allowed. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Entry fellowships use departmental nomination and no separate applicant application; no additional applicant
referee requirement published. [s9]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb emails requests when the applicant activates Submit the Request. Merely entering details is not the
documented trigger. Address changes saved through the Activity page cancel/reissue the request. [s12]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations may be sent before final application submission; submission is not a prerequisite. Interfolio/similar
delivery accepted, with optional evaluator-only questions bypassable. [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Activity page shows Completed in real time for successfully submitted online references. Mailed/emailed
alternatives do not appear there; confirm those with Math. [s13]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Referee can use Revise before applicant submits; after submission, contact ApplyWeb support. Reapplication
requires new application, fee and credentials; no automatic previous-year reactivation. Interfolio is permitted,
but confirm any school's recency expectation and do not assume automatic portal reuse. [s2] [s4] [s14]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload. Faithful paraphrase: relevant education, research and employment; central guidance also
suggests honors, publications/presentations, service and memberships. No page/font limit published. Portal
accepts PDF, DOC/DOCX, TXT/RTF, JPG/TIF; a link is not specified as substitute. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required upload. Faithful paraphrase of Math prompt: intellectual preparation, research experience,
mathematical interests and graduate-study plans. Described as brief, without a public word/page/font limit.
General Laney guidance additionally asks how interests developed, tentative research and degree preparation;
Math-specific prompt governs. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional for Math. Central current title is Statement on Building Collaborative and Respectful Graduate
Communities, maximum 500 words. Faithful paraphrase: how background, experiences or perspective
contribute to an engaged and equitable academic community; optionally connect values to graduate
participation and career goals. Upload; font/page rules unverified. Math still calls it diversity statement. [s1] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within SOP, including interests and plans; no separate research-interest document listed.
Independent prompt/length/upload permission unknown. [s1]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No formal separate research proposal listed; tentative research belongs in SOP. Separate formatting and
attachment permission unverified. [s1] [s2]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Explicitly no separate writing sample required for Mathematics. Permission to add an unsolicited thesis/paper
and upload-versus-link rules not published. [s1]

Publications list [Standing rule]
May list publications/presentations in required CV. Separate publications-list or paper-file requirement not
found; do not infer permission to upload all papers. [s2]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No standalone course-list assignment found; prompt/length/format/upload rule unverified. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No separate entry-fellowship application or essay required by published Laney policy; departments nominate.
Hardship fee-waiver requires evidence, such as need-based-aid letter, ETS reduction, unemployment proof or
international economic/currency circumstances; redact sensitive identifiers. No published essay word limit. [s7]
[s9]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No additional public Math short-answer assignment found. Check the selected Fall 2027 form before drafting
for portal-only prompts. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Current eligible-PhD base stipend is USD43,260 annually for FY 2026-27; this is not a Fall 2027 promise, since
the displayed agreement expires August 24 2027. Full tuition and100% student health premium; ordinary
students pay semester fees. Woodruff adds USD5,000 annually and covers fees for five years; Laney fellowship
adds USD2,500 annually for five years. Specific 2027 amount and payment-period details belong in offer. [s9]
[s10]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five years of stipend and health support with satisfactory progress; tuition scholarships up to seven years.
Extensions depend on program; advanced-student fellowships may support later completion. Math states PhD
admits receive full tuition and stipend. [s8] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Math funding statement applies to PhD admits and central package has no citizenship restriction stated.
International hardship fee waivers explicitly allowed. External fellowships may have citizenship restrictions; no
blanket eligibility inferred. [s7] [s8] [s9]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory academic progress and availability for research/instructional appointments under CBA. Math's
2026 handbook includes teacher training, two TA semesters and two instructor-of-record semesters; CBA
distinguishes academic TATTO training from compensated service and limits ordinary uncompensated-extra
teaching assignments. [s10] [s11]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate application for special acceptance fellowships; programs nominate. Ordinary funded PhD
consideration is through admission application. [s8] [s9]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Woodruff, Centennial, Laney and Women in Natural Sciences entry fellowships; WiNS includes Math applicants
regardless of sex. Professional-development funds cover research/training/conferences, with up to USD7,500
across the initial five years under the current CBA. Advanced-student and external funding available subject to
separate rules. [s9] [s10]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD75 nonrefundable, paid by credit card online; separate fee for each program. [s3] [s4]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
International applicants eligible for limited need-based waivers. Request via Signature-page link, upload

evidence, allow five business days. Qualifying graduate-preparation program participation can trigger
automatic waiver by checking the program; ask laney.aero@emory.edu for an unlisted program. Apply before
paying. [s7]

Emory University
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• English exemption is discretionary; a UChicago degree is not a published automatic waiver.
• Current stipend source ends before Fall 2027.
• Use current faculty directory; old brochure lists departed faculty.
• Separate MS route has different deadline and only partial tuition scholarship, with no teaching assistantship.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Direct PhD route accepts an undergraduate mathematics degree or equivalent preparation; master's not
required. UChicago BA must be awarded before first semester. International status is based on
citizenship/residency, regardless of studying in the US; no citizenship exclusion for Math admission is listed. [s2]
[s4] [s5] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select Math PhD in Laney ApplyWeb; prepare CV, SOP, registrar-issued transcript scans and three referees. Ask
Math for an English-test exception before omitting TOEFL. Financial-hardship waiver takes five business days
and must be requested before fee payment. No supervisor pre-approval requirement found. [s1] [s3] [s7]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No supervisor endorsement prerequisite found. Discuss fit with current faculty; DGS Suresh Venapally handles
recruiting and graduate concerns. No faculty member's 2027 intake is guaranteed by directory status. [s1] [s16]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb supports saved drafts, file uploads and pre-submission recommendation requests. Submitted
application edits require contacting program. Activity page tracks online letters; no prior-year reactivation.
General admissions email lgsadmissions@emory.edu. [s2] [s3] [s4] [s13]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Laney explicitly accepting Fall 2027 applications. Math deadline remains standing December 15; 2027 stipend
and scholarship specifics not yet established in the sources checked. [s1] [s3] [s10]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing Math PhD date: December 15, 11:59 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. Laney application is explicitly open
for Fall 2027, but Math's date itself does not print a year; confirm December 15, 2026 in the selected portal.
January 31 is MS only. [s1] [s3] [s4]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No separate standard or special-entry-fellowship deadline published; admission applicants are considered
through program nomination. Use the complete Math deadline. Exact internal fellowship nomination dates not
public. [s1] [s9]

Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Aim for the application deadline, December 15 at 11:59 p.m. EST (year confirmation above). Central FAQ
permits late letters technically but warns review begins promptly and a file without three is incomplete; no
guaranteed Math grace period. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Test-score receipt [Conflict]
Math permits self-reported scores for review, official reports before enrollment. Central program-requirements
page more generally instructs official score reporting; request Math clarification if relying on self-report. ETS
institution5187; central says no department code needed, Math lists0703. Do not delay submission awaiting
official matching. [s1] [s4] [s26]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Uploaded required documents with application; official transcripts only after accepting, before first semester. A
distinct late-document grace deadline is not published. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Unresolved]
Laney application page refers to the April 15 resolution for funded admission offers, but a Math-specific Fall
2027 commitment deadline is not stated. Verify the actual offer and current institution participation; do not
mistake FAQ's expected decision-release period for an acceptance deadline. [s3] [s4]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL normally required for non-native speakers. Math allows exceptions for substantial time living in an
English-speaking country; no numerical minimum, test-age rule or alternate-test list is published on Math's
page. Central office makes English requirements program-specific. New non-native-English students also
undergo August English Language Support Program assessment. [s1] [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
Not an automatic published US-degree waiver: UChicago residence/education supports a request under Math's
discretionary substantial-time exception. Obtain Math's confirmation. Admission exception does not establish
exemption from August language assessment. [s1] [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Not required; submitted scores explicitly considered. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not required. Math does not explicitly say whether optional subject scores are considered or ignored, unlike its
clear general-GRE policy; confirm if planning submission. [s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload registrar-issued unofficial scans from all postsecondary institutions, including non-degree study and
current institution; student-system webpage printouts are unacceptable. Remove document password/expiry
restrictions. Exchange transcript can be omitted if course names, credits and grades appear on the degree
transcript; if separately listed, attach a transcript or explanatory note. Non-English records need original plus
notarized translation. No mandatory credential evaluation for Math. Official copies after acceptance. [s2] [s4] [s5]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list in public requirements; portal-only fields unverified. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate syllabi/course-description upload listed; optional permission and format unknown. [s1]

Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required from people familiar with academic performance; optional fourth allowed. [s1] [s2]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Entry fellowships use departmental nomination and no separate applicant application; no additional applicant
referee requirement published. [s9]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb emails requests when the applicant activates Submit the Request. Merely entering details is not the
documented trigger. Address changes saved through the Activity page cancel/reissue the request. [s12]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Invitations may be sent before final application submission; submission is not a prerequisite. Interfolio/similar
delivery accepted, with optional evaluator-only questions bypassable. [s2]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Activity page shows Completed in real time for successfully submitted online references. Mailed/emailed
alternatives do not appear there; confirm those with Math. [s13]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Referee can use Revise before applicant submits; after submission, contact ApplyWeb support. Reapplication
requires new application, fee and credentials; no automatic previous-year reactivation. Interfolio is permitted,
but confirm any school's recency expectation and do not assume automatic portal reuse. [s2] [s4] [s14]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required upload. Faithful paraphrase: relevant education, research and employment; central guidance also
suggests honors, publications/presentations, service and memberships. No page/font limit published. Portal
accepts PDF, DOC/DOCX, TXT/RTF, JPG/TIF; a link is not specified as substitute. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required upload. Faithful paraphrase of Math prompt: intellectual preparation, research experience,
mathematical interests and graduate-study plans. Described as brief, without a public word/page/font limit.
General Laney guidance additionally asks how interests developed, tentative research and degree preparation;
Math-specific prompt governs. [s1] [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Optional for Math. Central current title is Statement on Building Collaborative and Respectful Graduate
Communities, maximum 500 words. Faithful paraphrase: how background, experiences or perspective
contribute to an engaged and equitable academic community; optionally connect values to graduate
participation and career goals. Upload; font/page rules unverified. Math still calls it diversity statement. [s1] [s6]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Required within SOP, including interests and plans; no separate research-interest document listed.
Independent prompt/length/upload permission unknown. [s1]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No formal separate research proposal listed; tentative research belongs in SOP. Separate formatting and
attachment permission unverified. [s1] [s2]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
Explicitly no separate writing sample required for Mathematics. Permission to add an unsolicited thesis/paper
and upload-versus-link rules not published. [s1]

Publications list [Standing rule]
May list publications/presentations in required CV. Separate publications-list or paper-file requirement not
found; do not infer permission to upload all papers. [s2]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No standalone course-list assignment found; prompt/length/format/upload rule unverified. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No separate entry-fellowship application or essay required by published Laney policy; departments nominate.
Hardship fee-waiver requires evidence, such as need-based-aid letter, ETS reduction, unemployment proof or
international economic/currency circumstances; redact sensitive identifiers. No published essay word limit. [s7]
[s9]
Other short answers / materials [Unresolved]
No additional public Math short-answer assignment found. Check the selected Fall 2027 form before drafting
for portal-only prompts. [s1] [s3]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Current eligible-PhD base stipend is USD43,260 annually for FY 2026-27; this is not a Fall 2027 promise, since
the displayed agreement expires August 24 2027. Full tuition and100% student health premium; ordinary
students pay semester fees. Woodruff adds USD5,000 annually and covers fees for five years; Laney fellowship
adds USD2,500 annually for five years. Specific 2027 amount and payment-period details belong in offer. [s9]
[s10]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five years of stipend and health support with satisfactory progress; tuition scholarships up to seven years.
Extensions depend on program; advanced-student fellowships may support later completion. Math states PhD
admits receive full tuition and stipend. [s8] [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Math funding statement applies to PhD admits and central package has no citizenship restriction stated.
International hardship fee waivers explicitly allowed. External fellowships may have citizenship restrictions; no
blanket eligibility inferred. [s7] [s8] [s9]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory academic progress and availability for research/instructional appointments under CBA. Math's
2026 handbook includes teacher training, two TA semesters and two instructor-of-record semesters; CBA
distinguishes academic TATTO training from compensated service and limits ordinary uncompensated-extra
teaching assignments. [s10] [s11]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No separate application for special acceptance fellowships; programs nominate. Ordinary funded PhD
consideration is through admission application. [s8] [s9]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Woodruff, Centennial, Laney and Women in Natural Sciences entry fellowships; WiNS includes Math applicants
regardless of sex. Professional-development funds cover research/training/conferences, with up to USD7,500
across the initial five years under the current CBA. Advanced-student and external funding available subject to
separate rules. [s9] [s10]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD75 nonrefundable, paid by credit card online; separate fee for each program. [s3] [s4]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
International applicants eligible for limited need-based waivers. Request via Signature-page link, upload

evidence, allow five business days. Qualifying graduate-preparation program participation can trigger
automatic waiver by checking the program; ask laney.aero@emory.edu for an unlisted program. Apply before
paying. [s7]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Math accepts self-reported scores until enrollment whereas central instructions generally request official
reports. Current community essay title differs from Math's older diversity wording. Archived brochure's faculty
list is obsolete; current directory includes 2025/26 recruits and omits several former Emory faculty. [s1] [s6] [s15]
[s21] [s26]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm December 15, 2026 in portal, discretionary UChicago English exemption, TOEFL
minima/age/alternatives if needed, optional MathGRE treatment, official-score timing, SOP/CV limits, Fall 2027
funding and commitment terms, and each faculty member's advising availability. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s9] [s10]
